meta.title: Vendor Onboarding (WF-VM-001): end-to-end order of steps
gaps: Trigger a vendor submitting an onboarding form
Run the automatic Form Completeness Check step
Complete Finance Approval as the Finance Controller
Complete Legal / Compliance Review as Legal / Compliance
Complete Category Manager Endorsement as the Category Manager
Run the automatic Vendor Activation step
Verify the workflow history shows all five steps in order with each actor and outcome
Verify the vendor status changes to Active
Verify SAP MDG synchronization is triggered when integration is enabled
